About this Calculator

Estimates the maximum home price you can afford using the standard 28/36 debt-to-income guideline lenders commonly use: housing costs at or under 28% of gross income, and total debts at or under 36%. This is a general guideline, not a lending decision — actual approval depends on your specific lender, credit profile, and other factors.
